title: 第七章 她一下子感受到什么叫血脉相连
content_zh:
宣云溪骂完，空气寂静了一瞬，霍廷深和杜若依的脸色已经不能用难看来形容了。

    他俩都是文明人，骂人也骂得委婉，根本比不过宣云溪这个真泼妇，宣云溪叉着腰露出胜利的微笑。

    她正要发表几句胜利宣言，病房的门被推开了，霍老太太阴着一张走了过来。

    “奶奶，你怎么来了？”

    霍廷深朝霍老太太走去，霍老太太却和他擦肩而过，来到宣云溪面前，抬手一巴掌甩了过去。

    啪的一声，宣云溪脸上出现了五个红红的手指印，她愣住了。

    反应过来后，她只感觉脸颊火辣辣的疼，一股愤怒又屈辱的感觉慢慢涌了上来。

    “奶奶。”

    霍廷深眉头微蹙，想说些什么，突然间从刚才起就一直待在沙发旁的霍逸和霍灵冲了过来，挡在宣云溪面前。

    霍逸明显有些害怕，可还是梗着脖子道：“太奶奶你为什么打妈妈？你不能那么做！”

    霍灵都快吓出眼泪来了，可她没有退缩，小心翼翼地道：“妈妈没有错，妈妈凭什么挨打……”

    宣云溪怔愣地看着两个小孩儿。

    在这种时候，站出来保护她的竟会是她的孩子。

    “你俩说什么？你俩也被你妈妈带歪了？”霍老太太面容阴翳。

    刚刚她在外面听见宣云溪骂杜若依了。

    这些年杜若依陪伴在她身边，既是她心里的亲孙女，也是她看中的孙媳妇，杜若依被宣云溪欺负她根本忍不了。

    “伸手。”霍老太太厉声道。

    她在霍家的威严不容任何人挑衅，更何况这两个小孩明显是非不分了，身为霍家的大家长她有责任教训。

    霍逸平常是个过分早熟的小孩子，这会儿却浑身激灵了一下，条件反射般地伸出小手。啪的一声，霍老太太狠狠打了他一下，宣云溪吓了一跳。

    看着霍逸迅速红肿起来的掌心，还有他紧紧抿着嘴努力忍住眼泪的样子，一股强烈的怒火从心里升起，灼烧着她的心肺。

    “该你了。”霍老太太看向霍灵，眉眼凌厉。

    霍逸把霍灵挡在身后，伸出另一只手，“太奶奶，别打妹妹了，打我吧。”

    霍灵缩在霍逸身后，小身子微微颤抖，霍老太太冷眼看着他俩。

    “好啊，真是兄妹情深啊，那我就满足你！霍灵，看好你哥哥是怎么挨打的……”
content_en:
After Xuanyunxi finished cursing, the air was silent for a moment. The expressions of Huo Tingshen and Du Ruoyi could no longer be described as ugly.

    Both of them were civilized people, and they scolded people politely. They were no match for Xuanyunxi, a real shrew. Xuanyunxi put her hands on her hips and smiled in victory.

    Just as she was about to make a few declarations of victory, the door to the ward was pushed open, and Mrs. Huo came over with a grim expression.

    "Grandma, why are you here?"

    Huo Tingshen walked towards Mrs. Huo, but Mrs. Huo passed him by, came to Xuanyunxi, raised her hand and slapped her away.

    With a snap, five red finger prints appeared on Xuanyunxi's face, and she was stunned.

    After she reacted, she felt a burning pain on her cheek, and a feeling of anger and humiliation slowly came up.

    "Grandma."

    Huo Ting frowned slightly and wanted to say something. Suddenly Huo Yi and Huo Ling, who had been staying by the sofa since just now, rushed over and stood in front of Xuanyun Xi.

    Huo Yi was obviously a little scared, but he still frowned and said, "Grandma, why did you hit mom? You can't do that!"

    Huo Ling was almost scared to tears, but she did not flinch and said cautiously: "Mom is not wrong, why should I be beaten..."

    Xuanyunxi looked at the two children blankly.

    At this time, it was her children who stood up to protect her.

    "What did you two say? You two were also led astray by your mother?" Mrs. Huo's face was gloomy.

    Just now she heard Xuanyunxi scolding Du Ruoyi outside.

    Du Ruoyi has been by her side these years. She is not only her granddaughter in her heart, but also the grandson-in-law she likes. She can't stand Du Ruoyi being bullied by Xuan Yunxi.

    "Reach out your hand." Old Mrs. Huo said sternly.

    Her dignity in the Huo family does not allow anyone to challenge them, not to mention that the two children obviously have no distinction between right and wrong. As the head of the Huo family, she has the responsibility to teach them a lesson.

    Huo Yi was usually an overly precocious child, but now his whole body became excited and he stretched out his little hand like a reflex. With a snap, Mrs. Huo hit him hard, and Xuan Yunxi was startled.

    Seeing Huo Yi's palms that were rapidly becoming red and swollen, and the way he pursed his lips tightly and tried to hold back tears, a strong anger rose from her heart, burning her heart and lungs.

    "It's your turn." Mrs. Huo looked at Huo Ling with sharp eyebrows.

    Huo Yi blocked Huo Ling behind him and stretched out his other hand, "Grandma, stop hitting my sister, hit me instead."

    Huo Ling huddled behind Huo Yi, her little body trembling slightly. Mrs. Huo looked at them coldly.

    "Okay, the love between brother and sister is really deep, then I will satisfy you! Huo Ling, watch how your brother gets beaten..."
title_en: Chapter 7 She suddenly felt what blood connection means
